value: The article highlights a rare and significant exhibition of the *Très Riches Heures du Duc de Berry*, an exquisitely illuminated 15th-century Book of Hours begun by the Limbourg brothers. Hailed for its staggering originality and pioneering full-page calendar miniatures that mark the advent of the Renaissance in Northern Europe, its renowned calendar pages are on public display for only the third time ever at the Condé Museum in the Château de Chantilly. This critically acclaimed exhibition, considered one of the world's most important, further contextualizes the masterpiece with an extensive collection of other medieval manuscripts and artworks, offering a unique opportunity to engage with the Western European medieval period.
